name: rtl-agent-tools
description: RTL support, YOLO auto-approval, auto-resume on rate limits, in-conversation search, and quick-prompt buttons for Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, Gemini Code Assist, and Copilot Chat.

commands.title: RTL & Agent Tools: Check and Inject
RTL & Agent Tools: Configure Custom CSS Loader
RTL & Agent Tools: Remove All Injections

rtlForVsCodeAgents.autoInject.description: Automatically detect new agent (Claude Code / Codex / Gemini) versions and re-inject RTL support so it keeps working after the agent updates.

rtlForVsCodeAgents.checkIntervalHours.description: How often to re-check the agents for a new version (in hours). 0 disables periodic checks (startup only).

rtlForVsCodeAgents.autoConfigureCustomCs.description: Automatically configure Custom CSS and JS Loader to load the RTL script (needed for Copilot Chat).

rtlForVsCodeAgents.userMessageBorder.markdownDescription:
Show a colored border around user messages for easy identification.

**Tip:** It's easier to toggle this by right-clicking the ↑↓ navigation buttons — changes are instant (no reload needed). This setting is only used as the initial default on first install.

rtlForVsCodeAgents.yoloCountdownSeconds.markdownDescription:
YOLO mode countdown duration (seconds) before auto-approving tool calls.

**0 = instant** (no progress bar).

**Tip:** It's easier to change this by right-clicking the 💪 button directly — changes are instant and persistent (no reload needed). This setting is only used as the initial default on first install.

label.description: Short label shown on the button (emoji or a few characters work best).

text.description: The text to insert into the agent input box when the button is clicked.

rtlForVsCodeAgents.quickPrompts.markdownDescription:
Quick-prompt buttons: each entry adds a button to the agent toolbar that inserts its text into the input box.

**Tip:** It's easier to manage these by right-clicking the ⚡ button in the toolbar — changes are instant (no reload needed). This setting is only used to seed the defaults on first install.
